req.title: Delete unknown returns 404
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 when DELETE targets a non-existent task id.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-014 requires DELETE /tasks/{task_id} to return HTTP 404 when the task does not exist. The violation was test[3] having kind=negative but heuristic=STC. STC (State Transition Coverage) is a structural/positive heuristic that traces valid state paths; a negative kind is incompatible. Fix: change test[3] kind from 'negative' to 'positive' because the test exercises a valid state transition sequence (exists -> deleted -> absent) where the 404 on the second call is the expected correct system behaviour for that state, not an error injection. All other tests are preserved exactly as before.

tests.name: test_delete_existing_task_returns_204
preconditions: A task is created via POST /tasks/ to obtain a valid task_id
actions: POST /tasks/ with title='cleanup me' to create a task
trace: R-TASK-014 — confirms the success path (task exists) returns 204, not 404; kills mutations that change 204->404 or 204->200

import sqlalchemy, app.database as _db, app.models as _m
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

_engine = sqlalchemy.create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
_m.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=_engine)

_db.SessionLocal.configure(bind=_engine)

client = TestClient(app)

assert r_create.status_code == 201
task_id = r_create.json()['id']
r_delete = client.delete(f'/tasks/{task_id}')
assert r_delete.status_code == 204
assert r_delete.content == b''

tests.name: test_delete_adjacent_id_not_inserted_returns_404
preconditions: A task is created (gets id N), then deleted; id N+1 was never created
expected: Detail string matches 'Task with id {N+1} not found'
trace: R-TASK-014 — BVA boundary ±1: id N exists, id N+1 never existed; kills off-by-one mutations in the id filter predicate

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

_engine = sqlalchemy.create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
_m.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=_engine)

actions: DELETE /tasks/42 where id 42 does not exist
